title: there is no throw-expression grammar: `throw` is a statement, and inside a fallible function it produces the Result error variant
notes: specification/control-flow.mdx, 'Throw Statements': 'The initial language MUST retain ordinary statement-form throw and MUST NOT add a Smithers-specific throw-expression grammar.' docs/DECISIONS.md 'Expression-oriented language' (Locked) says the same and defers the expression form to the TC39 proposal. The diagnostic is the grammar rule SMITHERS1000 rather than a migration diagnostic because this form was never part of the language; 01-result-lifting/throw-lifts-into-failure pins the statement form that IS supported.
